storage.desktopOnly: Storage details are available in the desktop app. This build keeps the library in memory only.
storage.locationBody: Your notes, attachments and versions live in this library folder.
storage.appDataBody: Settings, managed backups and downloaded models stay in NotaBene’s app folder: {{path}}
storage.syncWarning: You may place this folder in iCloud or Dropbox for best-effort access from a second Mac. Never open it for writing on two Macs at once: synced folders cannot merge SQLite databases safely.
storage.moveConfirm: NotaBene will save any open note, then verify and relaunch from the chosen folder. If it is empty, the current library is copied there. If it already contains a valid NotaBene library, that library is opened without being overwritten. Continue?
storage.moveErrorInUse: That folder already contains a NotaBene library or an unfinished copy. Choose an empty folder or one without NotaBene’s reserved files.
storage.moveErrorInvalid: That folder cannot hold this library. Choose a different folder outside the current library.
storage.moveErrorVerify: The copied library did not pass verification. NotaBene is still using the original, which was not changed.
storage.moveErrorReadOnly: The library cannot be moved while it is open read-only on this Mac.
storage.moveErrorUnsaved: The open note could not be saved, so the library was not moved.
storage.readOnlyBody: {{host}} currently holds its lock. You can read and export your notes here, but editing stays disabled until the other Mac closes NotaBene and you relaunch.
storage.modelsNote: {{size}} of that is the voice models you downloaded. Remove them under Speech to get the space back.
storage.walNote: {{size}} of that is the write-ahead log, which SQLite folds back into the database as you work.
storage.lastReclaimed: Automatic cleanup last reclaimed {{size}} of unreachable attachments.
storage.integrityHint: Checks every page of the database for damage. It reports what it finds and changes nothing.
storage.damagedTitle: The database reported problems at launch
storage.damagedBody: Your notes are still readable. Back up or export them now, then run the check below to see what was found.
storage.neverStored: API keys are not stored here — they live in the macOS Keychain and have no place in a backup or an export. There are no accounts and no telemetry: nothing in this folder is sent anywhere.

ai.mindMapEmpty: Generate a map of this note's concepts. You will see it before it goes anywhere near the note.

ai.cardStyleHint_basic: A question on the front, its answer on the back.

ai.deckExported: Deck written. In Anki, choose File → Import.
ai.question: Question
ai.flipCardHint: Click the card to flip it
ai.podcastIntro: A spoken revision episode. The script is written by your provider; the voice is your Mac's, and stays on it.
ai.podcastEmpty: Two steps. Write the script from your notes and read it over, then create the audio. Nothing is spoken aloud until you ask for it.
ai.speechUnavailable: Speech synthesis needs the desktop app on macOS. The script still works.
ai.audioPlaybackFailed: This audio could not be played. Create the audio again and retry.
ai.keepAudioHint: Save an MP3 on your Mac or attach it to this note so it remains available after you quit NotaBene.
ai.keepAudioPartial: Only {{done}} of {{total}} passages were spoken, so that is all an MP3 would hold. Create the audio again for the whole episode.
ai.audioAttached: MP3 attached. It is now available in this note's Attachments.

ai.askSourceTruncatedHint: Only the matching part of this note was used.

tasks.breakDownNothingToAdd: Nothing to add — the steps already on the list cover the work.

tasks.checkDisclaimer: Judged from your linked notes only. Class notes are not a record of work done, so check before you tick.

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc_general: Interface language, and whether NotaBene looks for new releases.
settings.desc_appearance: Theme and accent colour. Changes land on the window behind this one as you make them.
settings.desc_editor: The typeface and rhythm of the page, and how concentration mode behaves.
settings.desc_abbreviations: Type a short trigger, finish the word, and NotaBene replaces it with what you set here. Existing text is left alone.
settings.desc_speech: Which voice reads a note aloud, and how fast it reads.
settings.desc_aiProviders: Keys are stored in the macOS Keychain, never in a backup or an export. Nothing is sent anywhere until you ask for it.
settings.desc_backups: When a copy of the library is written out, and how long history is kept.
settings.desc_agent: Lets Claude Code and other MCP clients read and write your notes on this machine.
settings.desc_about: Version, what NotaBene promises about your data, and where its third-party code came from.
settings.editorMeasureHint: How much of the window the text uses. Adjustable from the page itself in concentration mode.
settings.fontPreview: The tangent at a point is the limit of the secants through it.
settings.focusSectionHint: How the app behaves under ⇧⌘F. Everything stays reachable — the command palette, the slash menu, and the panes themselves.
settings.focusLineHint: Let the paragraphs you are not writing recede.
settings.focusTypewriterScrollHint: Hold the line you are writing at one height instead of letting it walk down the window.
settings.focusHideChromeHint: The title bar and status bar leave until you move the pointer to the edge of the window.
settings.focusFullscreenHint: Enters full screen with the mode, which is the only way macOS will put its own window buttons away.
settings.checkForUpdatesHint: Asks GitHub for a new release. Nothing else ever leaves this machine.
settings.aboutPrivacyLocal: Every note, drawing and attachment lives in a folder on this Mac. There is no account and no sync.
settings.aboutPrivacyNetwork: The only outbound requests are to an AI provider you configured, the update check you can switch off, and nothing else. No telemetry, ever.
settings.aboutPrivacyKeys: API keys are held in the macOS Keychain and cannot appear in a backup or an export.
settings.aboutAiLaw: Transparency information under the EU AI Act, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689.
settings.aboutAiWhat: NotaBene has no AI of its own. Every AI feature is marked, and each one sends the text you point it at to the provider you configured — nothing leaves this Mac unless you start the action.
settings.aboutAiGenerated: Answers, rewrites, summaries, mind maps, flashcards and podcast scripts are generated by an AI model. They can be wrong, incomplete or invented, including when they sound certain — check anything you rely on against your notes and your sources.
settings.aboutAiTrace: Text an AI wrote enters a note through the same version history as your own typing, recorded as AI, so you can always see what changed and undo it.
settings.aboutAiResponsibility: You decide what to keep. If you hand in work an AI helped with, your institution's rules on that are yours to follow.
settings.desc_dataStorage: Where NotaBene keeps your data on this Mac, how much space it uses, and whether it is intact.

speech.voxtralLicense: I accept the CC BY-NC 4.0 model license and non-commercial restriction.
speech.installCancelled: Download stopped. You can start it again whenever you’re ready.
speech.testPhrase: This is a local voice running entirely on your Mac.
speech.mistralPrivacy: Only text you choose to speak is sent to Mistral. This is an explicit cloud engine and is never selected as a fallback.
speech.mistralKeyStored: Mistral API key stored in Keychain
speech.geminiPrivacy: Only text you choose to speak is sent to Google. This is an explicit cloud engine and is never selected as a fallback.
